name: relanote-workspace
description: relanote — a pure functional, statically-typed language for music. Workspace root.

scripts.ci: pnpm run check && pnpm run line-limit && pnpm run test && pnpm run test:native && pnpm run build && pnpm run lsp:test && pnpm run coverage && pnpm run docs:build
scripts.line-limit: fail=0; for f in $(git ls-files '*.mbt' '*.mbtv' '*.sh' '*.json' '*.yml' '*.yaml' '*.js' '*.mjs' '*.css' '*.html'); do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; n=$(wc -l < "$f"); if [ "$n" -gt 250 ]; then echo "$n $f"; fail=1; fi; done; exit $fail
